name: White Barn Inn, Auberge Collection
positioning: Historic coastal Maine inn in Kennebunk, with a main inn, cottages, suites and seasonal houseboats on the Kennebunk River (official name White Barn Inn, Auberge Collection)
best_for: Couples and adults who want a historic Maine coast inn with a notable restaurant
Travelers who want a stay on the Kennebunk River in a cottage or houseboat

facts.text: White Barn Inn is located at 37 Beach Avenue in Kennebunk, Maine, near Kennebunkport and the Maine coast.
White Barn Inn has been a local landmark for over 150 years.
The property joined Auberge Resorts Collection in 2018.
The inn is a 90-minute drive north of Boston.
The cottages offer direct access to the heated Infinity pool or views of the Kennebunk River.
Each suite has a gas-burning fireplace and a bathroom with a large jetted or soaking tub.
The houseboats are a 7 minute walk from the inn.
Little Barn is a relaxed, casual restaurant that serves dishes from local Maine farms and fisheries.
The spa offers massages, body treatments, facials, a couples spa suite and a sensory rain shower.
The outdoor pool is seasonal, with full amenities during the summer months.

highlights.text: The four houseboats, Cora, Nettie, Ivory and Grace, are each named for a member of the founding family of Cora Toothaker, who transformed the historic barn into an inn.
Private dining can be set up in the wine cellar, which holds 7,000 wine bottles.
Guests can borrow jackets, wellies and umbrellas from a Barbour Borrowing Closet.
Each houseboat has a private rooftop deck.
Guests can reserve a car from a small fleet of five Mercedes-Benz vehicles for four-hour blocks, first come, first served.

considerations.text: The houseboats are not recommended for children ages 1 to 12.
The Saltwood spa is smaller and treatment-focused rather than a place to spend an entire spa day.
The hotel can help arrange car service from Portland International Jetport but does not provide airport pickups or shuttle service.
